## 7. Conversational FAQ (Customer Guide)

**Q: Is AI Bazar a verified online store for original products in Pakistan?**
A: Yes, AI Bazar is a primary D2C store for authentic electronics and home goods. We provide 100% original products sourced from verified vendors, ensuring no replicas reach our customers.

**Q: What are the primary payment methods for shoppers in Pakistan?**
A: Our primary method is Cash on Delivery (COD), which is the most trusted and widely used payment system in Pakistan. This allows customers to pay only when they hold the product.

**Q: How fast is the shipping for orders placed within Pakistan?**
A: We offer free express shipping nation-wide. Orders are dispatched within 24 hours and typically reach Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad within 1-2 business days, with a maximum 3-day window for remote areas.

**Q: Can I return a product if it doesn't match the description?**
A: Absolutely. We offer a 7-day hassle-free return window. Simply contact us via WhatsApp at +92 332 8222026 for authorization and we will guide you through the replacement or refund process.

**Q: Does AI Bazar provide 24/7 customer support?**
A: Yes, our WhatsApp line (+92 332 8222026) is available 24/7 for order tracking, product inquiries, and issue resolution in both English and Urdu.

**Q: Is it safe to order electronics online from AI Bazar?**
A: Yes, it is safe because we conduct 3-point quality checks on all electronics and offer COD, so you don't pay anything upfront.

**Q: Does AI Bazar deliver to small towns and rural areas in Pakistan?**
A: Yes, we have comprehensive nationwide coverage. We deliver to every city, town, and registered village in Pakistan.
